theOneQuestion.question: Is QE-R7B1-04 closed correctly, with clinical safety precedence restored and the valid predecessor behaviour preserved?
theOneQuestion.answer: Yes. One precedence point in src/r6-adaptation.mjs reuses the handlers' own clinical screens and runs before R7-A's late-evidence question, the factual re-plan question (CAND-01) and the return's report-identity question (CAND-02). Engineering Q1-Q4 yes/no-regression/no-bypass; SSCTR ACCEPT_WITH_CONDITIONS; Quality READY with an 848-row differential, 0 ledger and 0 proposal-content differences, 0/260 nonclinical controls changed.

why: The U2 fix (f1259d3) routes a review's own clinical signal to CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED, with the handler's reason and no proposal, before any nonclinical re-entry question; late evidence stays in actualLedger and R7-A's confirmation question still applies to reviews with no clinical signal and no pending clinical state. U3 evidence on R7B2-FREEZE-1 passes G3-G7. The Engineering judge accepted (READY) and found QE-R7B2-01: a same-id return resend with a clinical reason plus a factual correction loses the predecessor's attached re-plan proposal, which is outside the §5 exemption, so §5 required the SSCTR and one narrow Quality review. Quality (READY) completed the differential and found the same shape from the graduation-withdrawal source (QR7B2-01); the SSCTR accepted both (r1 and addendum A1): a clinical route proposing nothing is what clinical-screen-first requires. Every other finding is pre-existing or an observation, not a bypass, and is routed with an owner (contract §10). No judge asked for a runtime change, so the correction cycle was not used.
